caseName: Firestone Plastics Co. v. United States Department of Labor
caseNameFull: Firestone Plastics Co., a Division of Firestone Tire & Rubber Co. v. United States Department of Labor

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. Application for stay, presented to Mr. Justice Marshall, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas and Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
